title: Instance-Wise Contrastive Graph Neural Network Enables the Discovery of Novel Aedes aegypti Larvicidal Compounds
summary: An instance-wise contrastive graph neural network screened molecules for larvicidal activity, followed by laboratory assays. Three predicted compounds showed measurable activity, including a potent lead; the limited acute nontarget testing and further evaluation do not establish safety or field effectiveness.

evidence.tested: Laboratory larvicidal assays found measurable activity for three predicted compounds, including a potent lead.
evidence.unknown: Only limited acute nontarget testing was reported; safety, field effectiveness and broader toxicology require further study.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
